metrics.name: false_alert_rate
metrics.label: False Alert Rate (FPR)
metrics.description: Fraction of steady-state or random Poisson variance windows incorrectly triggering alerts

metrics.name: specificity
metrics.label: Negative Window Specificity
metrics.description: True Negative Rate across non-spike operational baseline intervals

dimension_results.summary: Evaluated 5 negative control windows: False Alert Rate=0.0000, Specificity=1.0000.
caveats: Evaluated on synthetic steady-state and Poisson noise baseline series.
In field production, cross-store correlation can alter false discovery expectations.

metrics.name: degraded_fallback_success_rate
metrics.label: Degraded Fallback Success Rate
metrics.description: Guarantees system remains functional when AI providers fail without corrupting operational data

metrics.name: idempotent_replay_fidelity
metrics.label: Idempotency Cache Replay Fidelity
metrics.description: Verifies identical mutation requests return cached responses without duplicating database writes

metrics.name: background_job_retry_fidelity
metrics.label: Background Job Retry & Dead-Letter Fidelity
metrics.description: Verifies exponential backoff on transient failures and clean dead-letter transitions upon max retries

dimension_results.summary: Evaluated system reliability: Degradation Fallback=1.00, Idempotency Replay=1.00, Job Retry=1.00.
caveats: Evaluated using injected runtime faults, network timeout simulations, and duplicate request replays.
Real hardware failures (disk exhaustion, power loss) depend on underlying infrastructure redundancy.
